Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumatech renewal + capacity add — PO and billing entity question

Hi Laura,

Quick note as we prepare internal procurement for our Redwood renewal (annual commitment + 60% committed capacity add + 20 seats): purchasing asked which legal entity and remit address Redwood should be invoiced to. We have two potential payor entities in our org chart (Lumatech Systems, Inc. / Lumatech Labs LLC) and Treasury wants the invoice to route to the consolidated parent for this contract.

Two asks from our side so we can push this through Treasury this afternoon:
- Confirm Redwood invoice remit name + EIN you want on the PO/W9
- Confirm whether Redwood accepts one PO for the full renewal + add-on, or if you require separate POs for the committed capacity and seat charges (Treasury prefers a single PO)

We expect to issue PO 4567 if a single PO is fine. Also: we have standard net-60 payment terms on file with a few vendors; is there any issue with net-60 for this renewal? If not, we can include the net term on the PO and route for signature.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m if easier.

Best,
Grace Park
Head of Procurement, Lumatech Systems
grace.park@lumatech.com
[Phone: +1-415-555-0198]

Hi Grace — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the capacity pick-up. Short answers below and a couple of logistics items so procurement has everything they need: 

- Invoice remit / EIN: Redwood Inference, Inc. — EIN: 81-2345678. Remit address for invoices (AP): Redwood Inference, Inc., Attn: Accounts Receivable, 420 Terra St, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
- Single PO: We can accept one PO for the full renewal + committed capacity + seat add-on. Please include a line item breakdown if Treasury requires it (capacity units / seats / effective dates).
- Net terms: Net 60 is acceptable for this renewal; we will reflect that on our invoicing. Note: our standard hosted-tier billing runs on monthly invoices; for committed capacity we can issue consolidated quarterly invoices or monthly per Treasury preference.

Attachments: I can attach an up-to-date W-9 and our remit instructions — copying Naomi (billing ops) to attach the W-9 and confirm remit contact. Ben from Revenue Operations is cc'd to confirm the PO number mapping with the deal.

If you want the DocuSign routed to a specific Lumatech contact for signature, please send the name and email.
